reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

common_contract.population: Only the twenty-four explicit independently argued directions. Twelve Lean records and both candidate directions per record locate the inquiry; their product is not an admission rule.
common_contract.actual_use: The actual integrated system, condition or work practice is consumed by the named native decision, or an actual native condition is consumed by integration. A hypothetical vendor, generic topic similarity, job title or possible future decision is not enough.
common_contract.partial_input: One relevant input can matter before the receiving property wholly succeeds. A known failed necessary same-scoped condition can challenge its premise while other premises remain unknown. Adequate existing supply of an input does not erase the relation or require added work.
common_contract.human_limit: Machine behavior, merge counts and a mainline label do not establish competence, safe voice, fair distribution, management response or beneficiary value. Actual task/report/work-design/controlled-condition links are required for the stated human uses.
common_contract.evidence_kind: C27 and C26 remain separately executed old finite constructions. Four current human countermodels are explicit reasoning over possible histories, not new observations, experiments or employee studies. No causal field effect or actual institutional authority is inferred.
common_contract.history: All prior assignments,476unknowns/discriminators, rejected universal-rule criticism, missing originals, errors and UNKNOWN terminals remain intact. No old scientific source, control or finalizer is rerun or imported.
